{"metadata":{"description":"DSH（DeepSeek Harness）Web 插件：在 composer 工具栏注入一个「提示词库」按钮，管理可复用的 prompt 片段，点击即可插入当前输入框。支持自动学习：输入复杂 prompt 文案时，插件会自动识别并保存到提示词库。","id":"gh:1339441063","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-prompt-library","slug":"master1Sun/dsh-prompt-library","topics":["cordis","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-bundle","dsh-plugin","dsh-plugin-bundle","dsh-plugin-desktop","dsh-plugins","harness"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DSH（DeepSeek Harness）Web 插件：在 composer 工具栏注入一个「提示词库」按钮，管理可复用的 prompt 片段，点击即可插入当前输入框。支持自动学习：输入复杂 prom"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"pt 文案时，插件会自动识别并保存到提示词库。"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"🇨🇳 中文 | 🌐 **English**"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"# dsh-prompt-library"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"DSH (DeepSeek Harness) prompt library plugin: provides **prompt management**, **AI polish** and **pe"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"rsona customization** in the chat bar, helping you accumulate, reuse and continuously improve prompt"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"ona customization** in the chat bar, helping you accumulate, reuse and continuously improve prompts."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Key Features"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"### Prompt Library"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- Manage frequently-used prompts (title + body + tags), with search, sorting, tag grouping and usage"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"-count statistics
- Entry 1: the "Library" menu button above the settings button in the sidebar open"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"s a centered panel whose navigation reaches Data Management, Import/Export, Tags, Recycle Bin, Perso"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"nas, and Skills
- Entry 2: the prompt-library button beside the chat input opens recent/frequent pro"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"mpts with one click
- **Insert**: appends to the existing content in the input box
- **Overwrite**: "},{"id":"p7s6","text":"directly replaces the whole draft with this prompt
- **Insert & Send**: fills in template variables "},{"id":"p7s7","text":"and sends with one click (uses the variable dialog when it contains `{{}}`); outside `#` scenarios i"},{"id":"p7s8","text":"t is only available when the draft is empty, avoiding accidentally carrying existing content; when t"},{"id":"p7s9","text":"riggered by `#`, the trigger word is filtered out while the preceding text is kept and sent along
- "},{"id":"p7s10","text":"Type `#` to quickly trigger selection with real-time filtering
- The bottom shows the total number o"},{"id":"p7s11","text":"f tags and prompts in real time"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"### Generate Skills"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- Select prompts in "Library menu → Skill Manager" (skill import dialog) to generate DSH Skills in b"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"atch
- AI generates an English skill name and description from the prompt content; the skill is writ"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"ten to `~/.dsh/skills/<name>/SKILL.md`, and can be triggered by typing `/skill-name` in the chat box"},{"id":"p9s4","text":", or auto-matched by the model from the description
- A link between the prompt and the skill is cre"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"ated automatically; regenerating the same prompt **overwrites the original skill directory** instead"},{"id":"p9s6","text":" of adding endlessly
- If the body contains `{{variables}}`, the "placeholder auto-fill" capability "},{"id":"p9s7","text":"is marked at generation time — when using the skill, AI infers and fills them automatically from the"},{"id":"p9s8","text":" current semantic context, no manual input needed"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"### AI Polish"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"- The "AI Polish" button in the chat bar optimizes text with one click, then replaces it back into t"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"he input box with one click
- The polishing process follows the constraints of the persona settings"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"### Persona (AI read-only reference)"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Persona bodies live in the database (`prompts.db`: default persona in the meta table, custom ones in"},{"id":"p13s2","text":" the personas table), constraining every AI call and the session they apply to, forming a stable ass"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"istant persona. A complete default template is seeded automatically when missing; its content is **m"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"anually maintained by the user**, and AI only reads it without modifying it on its own. Multiple per"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"sonas (SOUL) can be created and bound per workspace/project — new sessions opened under a matched pa"},{"id":"p13s6","text":"th automatically adopt that persona."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"| Storage | Meaning | Purpose                                   |"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"| SOUL    | Persona | Identity, tone/personality, working rules |"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"- When the input is empty, matching prompts are recommended above the input based on recent chat con"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"text; click to insert into the draft
- The persona is the user's explicit configuration (including t"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"he default template), and AI follows its personality, tone and working rules accordingly"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"### Settings"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Under DSH Settings → Prompt Library, adjust: AI model selection, panel size, library-menu button vis"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"ibility, chat-bar button visibility/icon-only, `#` triggering, context recommendations, add-prompt-f"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"rom-selection, maximum stored prompts, etc. Changes take effect immediately."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Data Storage"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"The library uses **SQLite** (`node:sqlite`); all other configs and logs are stored under `~/.dsh/pro"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"es **SQLite** (`node:sqlite`); all other configs and logs are stored under `~/.dsh/prompt-library/`:"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Installation"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Start `dsh web`, click the "Library" menu button above the settings button in the sidebar to reach e"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"very feature panel; or use the prompt-library button beside the chat input, type `#` for the quick p"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"icker, and click "AI Polish" to polish your input with one click."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Development / Build"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## Screenshots"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## Author"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"**master1Sun**"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"- GitHub: https://github.com/master1Sun/dsh-prompt-library"}],"truncated":false}
